page.notes: Page is in roman and italic type, with Greek words. Several words are doubtful in the faint scan: "Chao", "Psychogonia" (printed Pfychogonia), "Abyssi". The printed text reads "Dialogo primo" and "Pimandro" as shown. Marginal mark near "Orpheus" is a faint printer's mark only. The printed signature "D 3" sits at the foot right, and the catchword is not clearly visible.
